summary: Amends CD-0160 D4: in checks mode only a DIRTY merge state blocks the success verdict, while UNKNOWN, BEHIND, BLOCKED, UNSTABLE, DRAFT, and empty never do, because none is evidence about check completeness. The request gains a mode of checks or merge with checks as the default; merge mode gates success on CLEAN or HAS_HOOKS and keeps UNKNOWN pending. Merged and closed pull requests are terminal statuses, every report carries merge_state, and the utility entry moves to version 3 with a purpose that states the repo-plus-selector input contract.
title: The ci-wait checks verdict blocks only on a dirty merge state
